definition: Miscellaneous Wages Code topics include **appointment of inspectors**, **maintenance of registers/records**, **claims procedure** before authority, **bar of jurisdiction** of civil courts where remedy lies under the Code, and **power to make rules**. These procedural provisions ensure enforceability of wage rights in practice.
